newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-FRINGER OVERHAULS SWISS SQUAD FOR WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FRINGER OVERHAULS SWISS SQUAD FOR WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Swiss national coach Rolf Fringer on Monday announced sweeping changes to his squad for Sunday's World Cup qualifying match against Finland.
Following a 1-0 loss to Azerbaijan in their opening European group three qualifier, Fringer has brought eight new faces into his 18-man line-up for the match in Helsinki.
Among those left out is Grasshopper Zurich striker Kubilay Turkyilmaz, sidelined with a strained calf muscle.

Two of Switzerland's most experienced internationals -- defender Marc Hottiger of English premier league Everton, who has been capped 63 times, and Lausanne midfielder Christophe Ohrel (47 caps) -- have been dropped.
Lausanne midfielder Blaise Piffaretti and Neuchatel striker Adrian Kunz return after a four-year absence.
Grasshopper Zurich's 18-year-old defender Brent Haas is introduced to the squad for the first time.

Internazionale Milan midfielder Ciriaco Sforza, who said after a disappointing performance in Azerbaijan that he would turn down any nomination until the new year, has had a change of heart and is included in the line-up.
Defenders: Brent Haas, Stephane Henchoz, Yvan Quentin, Marco Walker, Ramon Vega, Raphael Wicky
Midfielders: Massimo Lombardo, Blaise Piffaretti, David Sesa, Ciriaco Sforza, Johann Vogel, Murat Yakin
Forwards: Christophe Bonvin, Stephane Chapuisat, Adrian Knup, Adrian Kunz.
